response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and infrastructure experience with exposure to AI-agent workflows and cloud technologies, aligning well with the core requirements. However, his direct experience with production-grade GenAI systems and RAG architectures is less explicitly detailed, warranting further exploration in an interview.
strengths: Extensive experience (10+ years) in full-stack development with TypeScript and cloud platforms, including AWS and Kubernetes.
Proven leadership in technical discovery and cross-functional collaboration, with a track record of mentoring and driving engineering excellence.
Hands-on contributions to AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling, showing familiarity with emerging GenAI frameworks.
concerns: Limited explicit documentation of 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions, particularly in enterprise GenAI contexts.
No direct mention of vector databases or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures in resume highlights.
While multi-agent systems experience is implied, specific frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI) are not listed.
